NFL DFS Wide Receiver Rankings: Week 11 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 22 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 22, 3:06 PM ET

CeeDee Lamb is the top-projected wide receiver on the Week 11 DraftKings main slate at 21.4 DraftKings points for $8,800, against Tennessee. Amon-Ra St. Brown (18.6, $8,200) and George Pickens (16.4, $6,800) are next.

Carnell Tate returns the most per dollar among wide receivers projected for at least 9 points: 2.74 projected points per $1,000 at $5,500.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 22, 3:06 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Wide receivers to know in Week 11

CeeDee Lamb, DAL vs TEN ($8,800)

CeeDee Lamb carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 21.4 DraftKings points at $8,800, the 5th-highest on the entire main slate. That is 2.8 points clear of Amon-Ra St. Brown. The model gives him 10.1 targets on 32.0 routes. The salary works out to 2.43 projected points per $1,000, 3rd of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Lamb averaged 21.4 points with a simulated floor of 7.9 and a ceiling of 45.9, and he holds 27% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Amon-Ra St. Brown, DET vs TB ($8,200)

Amon-Ra St. Brown projects 2nd at the position with 18.6 DraftKings points at $8,200. The model gives him 8.9 targets on 28.5 routes. The salary works out to 2.27 projected points per $1,000, 9th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Brown averaged 18.6 points with a simulated floor of 5.6 and a ceiling of 43.8, and he holds 16% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3.5-point favorite at home against Tampa Bay, with an implied team total of 26 in a game totaled at 48.5.

George Pickens, DAL vs TEN ($6,800)

George Pickens projects 3rd at the position with 16.4 DraftKings points at $6,800. The model gives him 7.6 targets on 33.3 routes. The salary works out to 2.41 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 29 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Pickens averaged 16.4 points with a simulated floor of 3.7 and a ceiling of 40.8, and he holds 22% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Dallas is a 7.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31 in a game totaled at 54.5.

Value: Carnell Tate, TEN at DAL ($5,500)

Carnell Tate projects for 15.1 DraftKings points at $5,500, which works out to 2.74 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 29 wide receivers the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 8.6 targets on 32.2 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Tate averaged 15.0 points with a simulated floor of 2.7 and a ceiling of 40.2, and he holds 21% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Tennessee is a 7.5-point underdog on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 23.5 in a game totaled at 54.5.
